# kopia_sources (Data Source)

Lists the snapshot sources the Kopia server knows, with the state of each: whether it is idle, uploading or remote, its effective schedule, when its next snapshot is due and its last snapshot. It needs a repository connected.

A source is a user, a host and a path. The list holds every source with a snapshot in the repository, from any host, every policy target with a user, a host and a path, and every source added in the Kopia UI. Kopia brings it up to date when a policy changes and every few hours (`--refresh-interval`, `4h` by default), so a source can lag behind snapshots taken or deleted elsewhere.

The state is the server's view as of its last refresh of each source. `status`, `current_task` and `next_snapshot_time` are hints rather than a reliable state machine: a source that has just been asked for a snapshot has no next snapshot time until that snapshot finishes, and a `FAILED` status stays until the next snapshot.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every source the server knows, from every host.
data "kopia_sources" "all" {}

output "source_status" {
  value = { for s in data.kopia_sources.all.sources : s.target => s.status }
}

# The sources of one host, with when each one's next snapshot is due.
data "kopia_sources" "host1" {
  host = "host1"
}

output "host1_next_snapshot" {
  value = { for s in data.kopia_sources.host1.sources : s.path => s.next_snapshot_time }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `host` (String) List only the sources of this host. Leave it out for every host.
- `path` (String) List only the sources of this path, compared as a plain string. Leave it out for every path.
- `user_name` (String) List only the sources of this user. Leave it out for every user.

### Read-Only

- `local_host` (String) Host name the server takes snapshots as, the same as `hostname` of `kopia_repository_status`. Sources of this host are local: the server snapshots them.
- `local_username` (String) User name the server takes snapshots as, the same as `username` of `kopia_repository_status`.
- `multi_user` (Boolean) Whether the server sees the sources of every user and host: true for a repository connected directly to its storage, false for one reached through a Kopia repository server.
- `sources` (Attributes List) The sources that match the filters, sorted by `target`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sources))

<a id="nestedatt--sources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sources`

Read-Only:

- `current_task` (String) Identifier of the server task taking the snapshot while `status` is `UPLOADING`, as the Kopia UI's task list shows it; null otherwise.
- `host` (String) Host the source belongs to.
- `last_snapshot` (Attributes) Newest snapshot of the source, complete or not, as of the server's last refresh of it; null when it has none. Its `id` can be out of date for a while after the snapshot is edited or deleted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sources--last_snapshot))
- `next_snapshot_time` (String) When the next scheduled snapshot is due, as an RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC; it may lie in the past for an overdue source. Null for a source that is only snapshotted manually or is paused, and normally also while a snapshot is pending or uploading and after one failed, until the server refreshes the source.
- `path` (String) Path that is snapshotted, as the host writes it.
- `schedule` (Attributes) Effective scheduling policy of the source — what its own policy and those it inherits from add up to — as of the server's last refresh of it. Empty when that refresh failed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sources--schedule))
- `status` (String) State of the source on this server: `IDLE` while a local source waits for its next snapshot, `PENDING` while a requested snapshot waits for a free slot, `UPLOADING` while one runs, `REMOTE` for a source of another host (or of any host on a read-only connection), which this server never snapshots, `PAUSED` for a source paused through the server's control API, and `FAILED` when the server last failed to read its policy or snapshots. `UNKNOWN`, `INITIALIZING` and `STOPPED` appear briefly while a source is added or removed.
- `target` (String) The source as Kopia writes it, `USER@HOST:PATH`: the form `kopia_policy` takes as the `target` of a path's policy.
- `upload` (Attributes) Progress of the snapshot being taken while `status` is `UPLOADING`; null otherwise. Sizes are in bytes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sources--upload))
- `user_name` (String) User the source belongs to.

<a id="nestedatt--sources--last_snapshot"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sources.last_snapshot`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description of the snapshot; empty when it has none.
- `end_time` (String) When the snapshot ended, as an RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the snapshot's manifest, which changes when the snapshot is edited.
- `incomplete_reason` (String) Why the snapshot is incomplete — `checkpoint`, `canceled` or `limit reached` — or null for a complete snapshot.
- `pins` (List of String) Pins that keep the snapshot from being deleted by retention.
- `root_id` (String) Identifier of the snapshot's root object, which two snapshots of unchanged data share; null when the snapshot has no root.
- `start_time` (String) When the snapshot started, as an RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC.
- `stats` (Attributes) What the upload that made the snapshot saw. Sizes are in bytes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sources--last_snapshot--stats))

<a id="nestedatt--sources--last_snapshot--stats"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sources.last_snapshot.stats`

Read-Only:

- `cached_files` (Number) Number of files found unchanged since the previous snapshot, and not read again.
- `dir_count` (Number) Number of directories snapshotted.
- `error_count` (Number) Number of errors that were not ignored.
- `excluded_dir_count` (Number) Number of directories excluded by policy.
- `excluded_file_count` (Number) Number of files excluded by policy.
- `excluded_total_size` (Number) Total size of the files excluded by policy.
- `file_count` (Number) Number of files snapshotted.
- `ignored_error_count` (Number) Number of errors the error-handling policy ignored.
- `non_cached_files` (Number) Number of files read and hashed.
- `total_size` (Number) Total size of the files snapshotted.



<a id="nestedatt--sources--schedule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sources.schedule`

Read-Only:

- `cron` (List of String) Cron expressions at whose times a snapshot is taken.
- `interval_seconds` (Number) Time between snapshots, in seconds; null when snapshots are not taken at an interval.
- `manual` (Boolean) Whether snapshots are only taken when asked for, never on a schedule.
- `no_parent_time_of_day` (Boolean) Whether the times of day ignore those of the policies the source inherits from.
- `run_missed` (Boolean) Whether a snapshot whose time passed while the server was not running is taken as soon as it can be; null when no policy says.
- `time_of_day` (Attributes List) Times of day at which a snapshot is taken, in the server's time zone. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sources--schedule--time_of_day))

<a id="nestedatt--sources--schedule--time_of_day"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sources.schedule.time_of_day`

Read-Only:

- `hour` (Number) Hour, from 0 to 23.
- `minute` (Number) Minute, from 0 to 59.



<a id="nestedatt--sources--upload"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sources.upload`

Read-Only:

- `cached_bytes` (Number) Bytes of files found unchanged, which are not read again.
- `cached_files` (Number) Number of files found unchanged.
- `directory` (String) Directory being read, within the source.
- `errors` (Number) Number of errors so far that were not ignored.
- `estimated_bytes` (Number) Estimated total bytes of the snapshot.
- `estimated_files` (Number) Estimated total number of files of the snapshot.
- `hashed_bytes` (Number) Bytes read and hashed so far.
- `hashed_files` (Number) Number of files read and hashed so far.
- `ignored_errors` (Number) Number of errors so far that were ignored.
- `last_error` (String) Error of the entry that last failed; empty when none did.
- `last_error_path` (String) Path of the entry that last failed; empty when none did.
